title: The Shattered Mirror - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: The Shattered Mirror trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: The Shattered Mirror phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Drops the White Serpent and Crimson Viper paired blades, so the reward is a loadout change rather than a stat bump.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
